title: Find another angle with same position
text: Notice that $$\frac{8\pi}{3}$$ is larger than one full rotation of $$2\pi.$$ We can subtract $$2\pi$$ (which is equivalent to $$\frac{6\pi}{3}$$ ) to find a simpler angle on the primary unit circle that is at the same position.

title: Evaluate the special value
text: The angle $$\frac{2\pi}{3}$$ is in the second quadrant. Tangent is the ratio of sine over cosine $$(\$\$y$$ over $$x\$\$)$$. $$Since$$ $$y$$ is positive and $$x$$ is negative, the tangent value is $$-\sqrt{3}$$.
